names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 12 iunie, «Sfântul Cuvios Onufrie cel Mare».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 12 Ιουνίου, «Όσιος Ονούφριος ο Αιγύπτιος», with the rank word and the place-phrase left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 12. јун ст. ст., „Преподобни Онуфрије Велики“ — Преподобни is the rank and comes off; Велики stays, because §5 of this wave’s brief is explicit that it is not a rank but the epithet «the Great», and it is what distinguishes him. `foldchk.py` holds no folder on either «Онуфрије Велики» or «Онуфрије», so the epithet is kept for fullness and not to break a fold.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 12 iunie — «Sfântul Cuvios Onufrie cel Mare»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 12ης Ιουνίου — «Όσιος Ονούφριος ο Αιγύπτιος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 12 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and gives no years. It is plainly the same man: the great ascetic of the Egyptian deserts, a Persian by birth, who went deep into the desert, was met by the hermit Hermias and settled under a great palm beside a spring, and died as abba Paphnoutios visited him, who buried him under that palm. The page records portions of his relics at the monastery of his name at Keratea in Attica and at the monastery of Leimonos on Lesbos. It keeps him on the same day as Peter the Athonite and prints one apolytikion naming them both. Its kontakion, «Φῶς νοητὸν καὶ οὐράνιον, Πέτρε», names Peter and not Onuphrius, and is a mis-hang so far as this folder goes: no hymn is taken from it here. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 25.06.2026 (12. јун ст. ст.) — „Преподобни Онуфрије Велики“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry. The heading is quoted as the Prologue prints it, without a closing full stop, as every heading of this wave is. The Julian 12 June is the same menologion number the folder’s `romanian` and `greek` rows already carry, so there is no second day and no §4 note is owed. A FIRST DATE ON A FOLDER THAT HELD NONE. The folder carried no `dates` object at all: doxologia gave no year and the `greek` note records in its own words that saint.gr «gives no years». This book states one flat and last: „Онуфрије сконча 400. године“. `death` 400 to 400, display «400», basis traditional, the Prologue’s own sentence in the note. No `birth`: the entry gives sixty years in the desert and a lifespan is refused, and no year may be reached by taking sixty from four hundred. THE VISITOR IS NAMED AND HE IS KEPT OUT OF THE PROSE. The entry turns on „монах Пафнутије“ — the monk Paphnutius, who finds him, is greeted by name, hears the life from his own mouth, sees the heavenly light and buries him. `ls saints | grep -i paphnut` returns nine folders and **not one of them is this man**: `paphnutius-of-the-thebaid`, the nearest by name and the one this folder’s own `greek` note calls «abba Paphnoutios», is Paphnutius the Confessor, bishop in the Thebaid, who sat at the First Ecumenical Council against Arius and whose lost eye the emperor Constantine kissed — a bishop and a confessor, not a desert monk on a journey. Refused by ruling 3, and because `related-floor` reads a prose name as well as a linked one the name is kept out of the paragraph altogether; the paragraph says «a monk who came to him» and the refusal is here. WHAT ELSE IS NEW. The sixty full years; the hair and beard reaching the ground and the body overgrown for want of clothing, every hair white as snow; that for a long time he ate nothing but earth, which is seldom found in the desert, until he had borne the struggle with the demons and an angel began to bring him bread; the palm that grew by his cell and bore good dates and the spring of living water that opened there; his own answer, „а највише храним се и појим слатко речима Божјим“; and that an angel of God brought him the communion every Saturday. The `greek` note already had the palm and the spring from saint.gr and names a hermit Hermias as the one who met him; **this book names no Hermias**, and the difference of visitor is recorded and not resolved. `types` UNTOUCHED: `venerable` and `hermit` are both there already, and Велики is not a rank but the epithet, which the display name carries. No `office`, no `locations`, no `related`. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only the verse.

hymns.text: Dumnezeul părinţilor noştri, Care faci pururea cu noi după blândeţile Tale, nu îndepărta mila Ta de la noi; ci pentru rugăciunile lor, în pace îndreptează viaţa noastră.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Cuvios Onufrie cel Mare; the page prints the common troparion of venerable fathers, naming no saint in the text.

english.text: O God of our fathers, who dealest with us always according to Thy gentleness, take not Thy mercy from us; but at their prayers guide our life in peace.

hymns.text: Τῶν Ἀγγέλων τὸν βίον ἐν σαρκὶ μιμησάμενοι, ὤφθητε ἐρήμου πολίται, καὶ χαρίτων κειμήλια, Ὀνούφριε Αἰγύπτου καλλονή, καὶ Πέτρε τῶν ἐν Ἄθῳ ὁ φωστήρ· διὰ τοῦτο τοὺς ἀγῶνας ὑμῶν ἀεί, τιμῶμεν ἀναμέλποντες· δόξα τῷ ἐνισχύσαντι ὑμᾶς, δόξα τῷ στεφανώσαντι, δόξα τῷ ἐνεργούντι δι' ὑμῶν πάσιν ἰάματα.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος α’, Τῆς ἐρήμου πολίτης — the first of two apolytikia on the page of «Όσιος Ονούφριος ο Αιγύπτιος», and the one that names him with Peter the Athonite; the same hymn stands on Peter's page too

english.text: Having imitated in the flesh the life of the angels, you were shown to be citizens of the desert and treasuries of graces — Onuphrius, the beauty of Egypt, and Peter, the luminary of those on Athos. Therefore we honour your contests always, singing: Glory to him who gave you strength, glory to him who crowned you, glory to him who through you works healings for all.

hymns.text: Τῆς ἐρήμου πολίτης καὶ ἐν σώματι ἄγγελος, καὶ θαυματουργὸς ἀνεδείχθης, θεοφόρε Πατὴρ ἡμῶν Ονούφριε· νηστείᾳ ἀγρυπνίᾳ προσευχῇ, οὐράνια χαρίσματα λαβών, θεραπεύεις τοὺς νοσοῦντας, καὶ τὰς ψυχὰς τῶν πίστει προστρεχόντων σοι. Δόξα τῷ δεδωκότι σοι ἰσχύν, δόξα τῷ σὲ στεφανώσαντι, δόξα τῷ ἐνεργοῦντι διὰ σοῦ πᾶσιν ἰάματα.

source.text: saint.gr, Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος α´, Τοῦ λίθου σφραγισθέντος — the second of two apolytikia on the page of «Όσιος Ονούφριος ο Αιγύπτιος»; it is the common of a venerable father with his name set into it, and names him alone. The page's spelling «Ονούφριε» is unaccented there as printed

english.text: A citizen of the desert, an angel in the body and a wonderworker were you shown to be, our God-bearing father Onuphrius: by fasting, by vigil and by prayer you received heavenly gifts, and you heal the sick and the souls of those who run to you in faith. Glory to him who gave you strength, glory to him who crowned you, glory to him who through you works healings for all.

death.note: The Охридски пролог for 12. јун ст. ст. ends the entry „Онуфрије сконча 400. године“. The folder held no date of any kind before this: doxologia.ro gives no year and saint.gr's page gives none either, as this folder's greek note already records. The sixty years the same entry gives for his time in the desert are a span and no year of birth is taken from them (5 October 2026).
